title: co-applicant test fixture still uses student (now a required-cohort), falsifying its own 'zero guarantor copy' invariant
evidence:
Primary fixture (no guarantor_* fields):
    #("employment_status", "student"),
    #("monthly_income_cents", "3500"),
    ...
    #("never_rented_before", "false"),
    ...
    #("has_guarantor", "false"),
    #("co_applicant_sharing", "yes"),

Test intent + assertion:
  // Validate / parse alignment: zero guarantor copy on the re-render. The
  // missing-fields banner copy is `form_copy.guarantor_missing_fields_error`
  // ("we just need a few more details about the guarantor") — its absence
  // here is the load-bearing assertion.
  string.contains(body, "we just need a few more details about the guarantor")
  |> should.be_false

New policy that the fixture now trips (application_handler.gleam):
  pub fn guarantor_required(values: List(#(String, String))) -> Bool {
    get_form_bool(values, "never_rented_before")
    || list.contains(["student", "unemployed"], get_form_value(values, "employment_status"))
  }
  ... True -> [#("guarantor", guarantor_required_error(values)), ..errors]
(form_copy.gleam) guarantor_required_error_student = "A guarantor is required — students need one to back the application."
detail: Student is now a required-cohort, so this primary emits the requirement row plus six guarantor_* field errors. The test's 'zero guarantor copy' comment is now false; it stays green only because the assertion targets guarantor_missing_fields_error (a different string). Sibling fixtures in gdpr/draft were moved student→retired; this one was missed.
recommended_fix: Change the primary employment_status from "student" to "retired" (matching the gdpr_integration_test and draft_integration_test fixes) so the test isolates the co-applicant error path it claims to, with no confounding primary guarantor errors.
